thread:
zoe_h: heads up — noticed a p95 spike on /api/chat after we flipped kernel_v2 -> kernel_v2_opt on the canary GPU pool.
perf-bot: alert: p95 /api/chat = 1800ms (baseline ~280ms) | sample=2051234565 | note=kernel-switch-canary
mike_r: I deployed the kernel change earlier this morning (small canary). can reproduce on canary nodes, not widespread yet.
anya: grabbing perf traces now — preliminary: KV cache hit rate for /api/chat dropped from ~92% -> ~61% around the time of the switch.
sam_j: hmm, could be batch formation change. dynamic token budgets might be letting a single long sequence hog the microbatch.
evan: can you paste the trace/log snippet?
zoe_h: log snippet:
```text
[2026-09-12T09:02:11Z] route=/api/chat seq=512 tokens_in=38 tokens_out=512 batch_size=1 kernel=kernel_v2_opt queue_wait=1200ms exec=400ms kv_hit=false
[2026-09-12T09:02:12Z] route=/api/chat seq=32 tokens_in=6 tokens_out=20 batch_size=4 kernel=kernel_v2_opt queue_wait=10ms exec=60ms kv_hit=true
```
mike_r: that looks like long sequences are monopolizing token budgets and pushing short requests into long queue waits. our token_budget_target calculation is currently tuned to p50 throughput, not p95.
anya: proposal — add a p95-aware per-route cap. simple formula: target_tokens = min(global_max, floor((p95_slo_ms / median_exec_ms) * base_tokens)). quick example: p95_slo_ms=400, median_exec_ms=80, base_tokens=256 -> target ~= 1280 but we then clamp to route cap (eg 1024).
perf-bot: perf ticket created INF-3897, dash=https://redwood/d/perf/queue-shaping?var-route=api/chat
sam_j: alternative shorter-term fix: enforce "priority-by-slo" queue policy so short-seq requests get served first during queue pressure, and add early_cutoff for >256 token candidates.
zoe_h: can we either rollback kernel_v2_opt on that canary pool or patch the batcher config to override token_budget for /api/chat? rollback would be fastest to reduce user impact.
mike_r: I'll patch the canary: add route_override for /api/chat -> token_budget_target=320, enable early_cutoff=256, keep kernel_v2_opt but limit its traffic. rolling update in ~5m. will report metrics.
evan: also request: mark very long sequences as non-cacheable or prefetch expected prefixes so KV cache doesn't get churned by rare long chats.
zoe_h: thanks — if the patch stabilizes p95 we'll promote the route override into the sculptor defaults and follow up with a short runbook and postmortem note. :thumbsup:
